meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用常驻内核引擎(DuckDB、Polars)分析数据:读取 CSV/parquet/JSON、分组、join、聚合、时间序列、分布与清洗,需要时出图,并报告行数与耗时。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV/parquet/JSON 数据集,或做分组、聚合、画图等数据任务时触发。

say.text: 读一下 data.csv,按城市分组统计订单量
say.note: 它会用 DuckDB 直接查询该文件并返回结果

say.text: 这份 parquet 内存装不下,用流式方式算月度趋势
say.note: 不会整表载入内存,改用流式查询

say.text: 把这份数据的分布画出来
say.note: 按可视化参考出图并做视觉检查

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars): reads CSV/parquet/JSON, does group-by, joins, aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, and charts when asked, and reports row counts and timing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze a CSV/parquet/JSON dataset, or to do group-by, aggregation, cleaning, charting and similar data tasks.

say_en.text: Read data.csv and count orders grouped by city
say_en.note: Runs a direct DuckDB query on the file

say_en.text: This parquet doesn't fit in RAM — stream the monthly trend
say_en.note: Queries without loading the whole table

say_en.text: Plot the distribution of this dataset
